lines.text: Some kids learn best *when they move*.
Learnigo's camera games need *just a webcam*. Children reach, freeze, trace and copy to learn.
*60+ games*, in eight groups, from letters and numbers to *my day*.
Bigger targets, more time, seated or one-handed play: *all adjustable*.
Try the camera games free at *learnigo.eu*
lines.say: Try the camera games free, at learnigo dot E U.
